description: This file defines API endpoints for session management in a backend API, including listing, creating, fetching, updating, and deleting sessions, as well as posting messages within sessions. It utilizes FastAPI, Pydantic models, and Supabase for database interactions.

methods.name: get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client using environment variables.

methods.name: list_sessions(user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all sessions for the current user.

methods.name: create_session(payload: SessionCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new session for the current user.

methods.name: get_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Fetches a specific session by ID along with its messages, verifying ownership.

methods.name: update_session(session_id: str, payload: SessionUpdate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Updates session metadata such as the title for the specified session ID.

methods.name: delete_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Deletes the specified session for the current user.

methods.name: post_message(session_id: str, payload: MessageCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Posts a user message to a session, requires at least one uploaded file, and generates a stub reply.
